theme: A quiet Sunday to clear the board
greeting: Just the 15-minute Sunday review with Mike this morning, Dan, then the day opens up. It's a good window to catch the overdue items that review exists to surface.

needsAttention.title: Kevin's waiting to hear you got his NACD note
needsAttention.detail: Kevin McGovern re-sent his NACD New England Maine Programming Committee note to your Gmail after it bounced off your old KPMG address, and he's asking whether it reached you.

needsAttention.title: Christmas SUV rental still unbooked
needsAttention.detail: Todoist flags this as the item most likely to bite: a refundable full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week thins out fast, and it's been due since Sep 14.

flagged.title: Gov & multilateral affairs role
flagged.detail: LinkedIn surfaced a Senior Director, Government & Multilateral Affairs opening.

flagged.title: Your KPMG address is bouncing
flagged.detail: Mail to your old KPMG address now hard-bounces, worth redirecting anyone still using it.

inbox.noise: Everything else is newsletters and retail, Foreign Affairs, cooking, travel and design promos.

recipe.title: Warm beet soup
recipe.why: Autumn's first roots are sweet and earthy now — a warm beet soup makes the most of them.

acts.line: The 9 AM review with Mike is the day's one fixed point, fifteen minutes to triage the board.
Nothing on the calendar after 9:15; the afternoon is entirely open.
An open evening at home with the girls in St. Pete.
